newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent low sulphur diesel diffs ease.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent low sulphur diesel diffs ease.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent low sulphur diesel differentials eased as expected on Thursday, continuing a downward move that set in a day earlier, traders said.
"It's thin, very thin," one Group Three trader said of trade as the Chicago and Group Three markets shifted focus to March deliveries.
Low sulphur diesel for March deliveries eased to 6.50/6.75 cents a gallon over NYMEX April heating oil in Chicago and 4.0/4.25 cents over the print in Group Three.
High sulphur was talked 3.25 cents a gallon over the print in Chicago and 2.50 cents over in Group Three.
